name: contract-example-dialog
goal: Read typed contract inputs and outputs as compact tables; open honest examples in an accessible shared modal.

evidence: Inputs and outputs use compact semantic tables with names, descriptions and data types. An info icon opens examples in the existing modal; source files stay hidden.

Standard entity contract checks require inline samples and omit dialog interaction. Extend those same component and responsive browser checks for tables, labelled examples, Escape, focus return and mobile fit.
